facts: Hobart is framed by kunanyi / Mount Wellington and the River Derwent; the official destination guide recommends waterfront walks. Location: opening destination description, “framed by the rugged figure of Kunanyi / Mount Wellington ... and ... River Derwent”.
The official guide identifies Mona, Salamanca Market and TMAG as cultural attractions. Salamanca is described as a Saturday tradition. Location: destination description and Insider tips.
